parsed.name: pharma_binary_basket
parsed.strategy: I bet the Q4-2026 FDA calendar pays: a diversified basket of PDUFA names with positive revision flow, sized small because a CRL averages -33% over five days, plus large-cap pharma ballast (MRK, LLY, ABBV, AMGN) that carries the same dated catalysts with far less binary risk. I overweight names where analysts raised targets into the event (VRTX, AGIO, CORT, PRAX) and keep every single binary at or under 5%. I would be wrong if a cluster of CRLs lands in November-December, if the Section 232 pharma tariff go-live on Sept 29 hits unshielded names like VRTX and ARGX, or if large-cap pharma de-rates on MFN pricing before year-end.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via a CRL-tail-sized FDA catalyst basket plus large-cap pharma ballast.

strategy.brief: Pharma binary basket: PDUFA/readout names from the CATALYSTS evidence, sized for the CRL tail (a CRL averages -33% over 5 days), plus large-cap pharma ballast. No single binary above 5%. Personal book: long only, 6-month horizon (126 sessions), no per-name cap, declare cash explicitly (0 is a declaration), graded net of costs against SPY.
